test_name: Configure RoostGPT Test Suite with Advanced Options
description: This test verifies the process of configuring a RoostGPT test suite with advanced options, including specifying environment variables, traversing subdirectories, and vulnerability checks.
steps: Navigate to the RoostGPT Config page by clicking on the 'RoostGPT Config' link.
Enter the test suite name in the input field '[data-testid="test-name-input"]'.
Enter the OpenAI token in the input field '[data-testid="openai-token"]'.
Click the unmask icon '[data-testid="openai-token-unMask-icon"]' to verify the token visibility.
Select 'Cloud' as the Git type by clicking the radio button '[data-testid="cloud-git-type-radio-button-selected"]'.
Enter the GitHub source token in the input field '[data-testid="github-source-token"]'.
Click the unmask icon '[data-testid="github-source-token-unMask-icon"]' to verify the token visibility.
Enable 'Traverse to all sub-directories' by clicking the checkbox '//div[@id='advanced']/div[2]/div[4]/div[2]/div/div/label'.
Enable 'Check for Vulnerability' by clicking the checkbox '//div[@id='advanced']/div[2]/div[5]/div[2]/div/div/label'.
Enter custom environment variables in the input field '[data-testid="new-custom-tag-input"]'.
Click the 'Save Configuration' button to save the test suite settings.
Verify the success notification indicating the test suite configuration has been saved.
expected_results: The test suite configuration is saved successfully.
All advanced options are correctly enabled and saved.
Environment variables are added without errors.
edge_cases: Invalid OpenAI token results in an error message.
GitHub token is invalid and prevents saving the configuration.
The 'Traverse to all sub-directories' option is enabled but not saved.
Checkboxes for advanced settings are disabled due to missing dependencies.
Attempting to save configuration without entering a test name results in an error.
dependencies: User is logged into the platform.
OpenAI account exists and is accessible.
GitHub repository is accessible with a valid token.
api_interactions: Validate OpenAI token via API call.
Validate GitHub token via API call.
Save test suite configuration using the platform's API.
performance_metrics: Time taken to save the configuration.
Latency during token validation API calls.
Platform responsiveness during advanced option selection.
accessibility_requirements: All elements are accessible via keyboard navigation.
Advanced settings are labeled with ARIA roles.
